descs.startRecord: Clear old events and start capturing keyboard & mouse
descs.stopRecord: Finish recording and add it to the list
descs.play: Replay the selected recording with playback settings
descs.startAutoClick: Start with the current interval and button
descs.emergencyStop: Stop recording / playback / auto click, release all keys, discard the recording

record.title: Record & Playback
record.subtitle: Capture keyboard and mouse actions with global hotkeys, then replay them automatically.
record.hookWarn: Global hook is not ready{perm}, hotkeys may not respond.
record.hookPerm: (grant Accessibility / Input Monitoring permission in system settings)
record.playbackDesc: Set repeat to 0 for endless loop. Jitter adds random noise to every interval so the replay looks less mechanical.
record.hotkeysDesc: Recording and playback are triggered by global hotkeys; auto-click hotkeys are on the Auto Click page. All hotkeys can be changed in Settings.

statusHint.recording: Capturing keyboard and mouse actions. Press the stop-recording hotkey to finish.
statusHint.countdown: Playback is about to start. Press the stop-playback hotkey to cancel.
statusHint.playing: Replaying the script. Press the stop-playback hotkey to interrupt.
statusHint.idle: Press the start-recording hotkey, then the play hotkey to replay.

record.recordsDescLine1: Finished recordings appear below. Click to select as the replay target, drag the dot on the left to reorder.
record.recordsDescLine2: Only saved recordings are written to the local folder.
record.emptyNone: No recordings yet. Press the record hotkey to start; finished recordings show up here.
record.editorDesc: {total} events in total{trunc}. Remove extra events or set a new replay start point.
record.evStartTip: Start from this event (drop earlier ones)
record.evCutTip: Delete from here to the end
record.msgListEmpty: The list is empty, nothing to export
record.msgTrimFail: No events within the trim range

auto.title: Auto Click
auto.subtitle: Configure the interval and button, then click repeatedly at a target position.
auto.jitterHint: Each interval is randomly scaled by this ratio so the rhythm is not perfectly uniform.
auto.pressHint: Set 0 to release immediately after pressing
auto.doubleHint: Each trigger performs a double click (hold duration is ignored).
auto.startDesc: Start with the current interval and button
auto.running: Clicking every {interval} ms · {count} clicks so far

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Hotkeys, recording behavior and data location.
settings.hotkeysDesc: Everything uses modifier combos to avoid clashing with other apps. Click Record, then press the combo you want.
settings.captureHint: Required for dragging and drawing, but greatly increases the number of events. Tune the sampling options below to control file size.
settings.backupHint: records.json is rotated into backups (records.json.bak.1 and on) before each write.
settings.trayHint: The tray icon shows the current status and offers emergency stop plus show / hide window.

dialog.unsavedMessage: {count} recording(s) are not saved yet and will be lost.
dialog.unsavedDetail: "Save and quit" writes them to the local folder first.
dialog.clearAllDetail: This cannot be undone. Unsaved recordings will be lost.
dialog.noImportableRecords: No importable recordings in the file
dialog.badFormat: Invalid file format or no events
